'''Tiroc Vhon''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who served under [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Biography==
In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], he was one of the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] who participated in the [[Battle of Birgis|battle]] of [[Birgis]], while secretly trying to leave intel on the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the assault on the main building of a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Vhon covered the Protectors exit with [[Suvar Detta]]. During the [[Battle of New Holgha|battle]] of [[New Holgha]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had Vhon and Suvar hold down an injured and resistant Jedi, [[Kubariet]], while [[Cham Detta]] administered medical assistance. Fett revealed to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] that the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] had tried to warn the New Republic about the attack on New Holgha, and that if the New Republic could set up a secure system they would continue to provide intel on the Vong. After Vhon warned of approaching Vong, Fett ordered him to help Kubariet to his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], and escort him out of the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Vhon carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that he picked up from a dying Jedi in battle.
